Definition: to be erect, i.e. bristle as hair
BiblicalUsage: çâmar means to be erect, to bristle as hair. It appears twice, in Job among them, and that use is enough to fix its sense.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe çâmar, little-used as it is, earns its place in Scripture.
